overview: Welcome to the official portal of Tanza Municipality, Cavite (Region IV-A). Tanza is a 1st class municipality with a population of 312,116 (2020 Census). This portal provides citizens, businesses, and visitors with public service guides, ARTA Citizen's Charter workflows, DILG Full Disclosure Policy files, and 24/7 emergency contacts.

mayor.name: Hon. Yuri A. Pacumio
mayor.message: Welcome to the dedicated portal of Tanza Municipality. We are committed to fast, transparent public service and full DILG/ARTA disclosure.
